description: This Java interface defines a repository for accessing LoanTransactionRelation entities from the database, extending Spring Data JPA repositories, and includes a custom query method to check for the existence of specific transaction relations.

classes.name: LoanTransactionRelationRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for LoanTransactionRelation entities, enabling CRUD operations and custom queries via Spring Data JPA.

methods.name: hasLoanTransactionRelationsWithType
methods.description: Checks if any LoanTransactionRelation exists with specified toTransaction, relationType, and where the fromTransaction is not reversed.
